## Overview

Allow `/v1/decisions` requests to carry ordered `input_text` and `input_image` content through vLLM's existing multimodal renderer. Each question receives the same input content followed by its own question suffix.

This PR is now based directly on main. All Winnow-specific prompt, option mapping, calibration, tests and documentation have been removed; those belong to #60713. The shared Decisions API predecessor has already merged.

## Behavior

- Preserve image/text ordering and native processor metadata for supported vision-language strategies.
- Reuse existing media fetching restrictions, cache salt and tracing.
- Reject images on text-only deployments without starting generation.
- Preserve the existing text-only request behavior.

## Ordering and strategy boundaries

The serving layer passes ordered input to `ReadStrategy.read_input` without checking strategy classes. Generic next-token reads preserve interleaved image/text content and the strategy's own question formatter. Fixed image-prefix protocols (Liquid d1, JointSchema and D3) retain their trained layout and reject unsupported interleaving with a request error rather than silently reordering content. This does not claim arbitrary interleaving support for every model.

## Validation

History cleanup: one image-API commit on upstream `ffa18e55`, with no merge commits. File tree is identical to the previous main-synced branch. **121 focused tests passed**, and contribution-file hooks including mypy passed. No GPU rerun for this history-only cleanup.

Latest main sync (`283d48f4`): **121 focused CPU/HTTP tests passed**. Resolved the adjacent-method conflict with #61192 by retaining both input adaptation and shared-prefix warmup. Token-only warmup remains enabled for text and is skipped for image-bearing input; image-ordering regression tests verify the skip. Contribution-file hooks including mypy passed. GPU E2E was not rerun for this main sync.

Latest refactor: **113 focused CPU/HTTP tests passed**, including exact media ordering, custom prompt formatting, fixed-protocol rejection and message-boundary preservation. Contribution-file hooks, including mypy, passed.

The **OpenAI SDK real-photo GPU E2E passed** on RTX4070 using `client.decisions.create(...)`, the shared stop-sign photograph and Qwen3.5-0.8B. It exercises predicate, choice and score, correct stop-sign recognition, normalized probabilities and token usage. The two text-server GPU tests passed before this refactor. No new GPU tests of Liquid/JointSchema/D3 weights are claimed.

Reproduce:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/decisions/test_decisions_e2e.py -v
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/entrypoints/generate/structured_decisions/test_strategies.py tests/entrypoints/generate/structured_decisions/test_decisions.py tests/entrypoints/generate/structured_decisions/test_question_types.py -q
```

Full upstream hardware CI has not been run locally. AI assistance was used; the human submitter reviewed and authorized this update.

nodes.body:
Thanks for the update! The overall approach looks good.

I have one concern about the current implementation:

Do we really need to check `isinstance(self.strategy, NextTokenStrategy)` in `serving.py`?

I think it would be better to let each `ReadStrategy` handle its supported input types rather than introducing strategy-specific logic in the shared serving layer.

Also, converting the input back to plain text and passing images separately may lose the original ordering of interleaved text and image content. Could we make sure this is handled correctly for other strategies as well?

   letters.
 - When each request carries one question over a state that changes from
   request to request, `--disable-prefix-caching` lowers latency.
+
+### Images through the Decisions endpoint
+
+`/v1/decisions` also accepts ordered user content containing `input_text` and
+`input_image` parts. Image URLs use the existing multimodal renderer, media
+restrictions and processor cache. Text-only models reject images. Context limits
+include expanded image tokens. Each question retains the input's media order.
+
+Ordered image inputs are interpreted by the selected read strategy. Generic
+next-token reads preserve interleaved text and images. Fixed image-prefix
+protocols (Liquid d1, joint-schema and D3 reads) accept images before text and
+reject interleaving with a request error instead of silently moving the images.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.
@Txoka Could you resolve the conflicts so we can move this forward quickly?
Please add an e2e test in the corresponding directory, and use a real image (you can refer to other tests).

Thanks for the update! The overall approach looks good.

I have one concern about the current implementation:

Do we really need to check `isinstance(self.strategy, NextTokenStrategy)` in `serving.py`?

I think it would be better to let each `ReadStrategy` handle its supported input types rather than introducing strategy-specific logic in the shared serving layer.

Also, converting the input back to plain text and passing images separately may lose the original ordering of interleaved text and image content. Could we make sure this is handled correctly for other strategies as well?
